text:
That makes sense. Grant work is draining, and mapping everything to a rubric is one of the more tedious parts. You've got the structure locked in now, which makes the rest much easier.

If it helps when you pick it back up, the most useful first step is just **gathering the data for the Statement of Need**. No writing, only pulling sources into a folder. It's low-effort and sets up the 30% section.

Otherwise, close the laptop. It'll be here tomorrow.
